strings.(시이나가 자신을 찾아온 사람을 보고 놀라지만, 환한 미소와 함께 뛰어가: (Shiina is startled by her visitor, then runs into her arms with a radiant smile.)
strings.(데이나가 품에 안긴 시이나의 머리를 쓰다듬어준다. 그러다 넘어질 것 같: (Dayna strokes Shiina's head as they embrace, then gently eases her back, as though about to lose her balance.)
strings.작은 언니, 미안해요. 나 때문에 넘어질 뻔했죠?: Sorry, Dayna. I almost knocked you over, didn't I?
If I fell, I'd roll all the way down to El Anoir Plains.
strings.언니도 참. 그런데 연락도 하지 않고, 무슨 바람이 불어서 왔어요? 이사: Oh, Sis. What brings you here without a word? It's not as though the chairman blew you in on the wind...
strings.클로리스 교장과 제피로스 이사장에게 할 이야기가 있어서 왔어. 겸사겸사: I have something to discuss with Headmistress Chloris and Chairman Zephyros. And I thought I'd see my lovely little sister while I was here.
strings.그 이야기 말인데, 저도 들으면 안 돼요?: Couldn't I hear that discussion too?
strings.언니, 저도 황가의 일원이에요. 언니의 일이 제 일이기도 한데, 뭘 망설: Sis, I'm part of the imperial family too. Your concerns are mine as well. Why hesitate?
strings.그렇게 말해도 오늘은 안돼. 하지만 약속할게. 때가 되면 이야기해 주겠다: Even so, not today. But I promise I'll tell you when the time is right.
I'll wait, Dayna. On one condition...
Have a meal with me in the dining hall. That will be enough for today.
strings.(데이나가 시이나의 어깨를 두드리려고 하던 순간, 손을 거둔다. 그리고: (Just as Dayna is about to pat Shiina's shoulder, she withdraws her hand. She quickly raises her staff and steps in front of Shiina.)
Yes, it seems safe now. It's gone...
strings.(시이나의 한마디에 데이나가 놀라 뒤를 돌아본다.): (At Shiina's words, Dayna turns back in surprise.)
strings.시이나? 지금 뭐라고 했어? 사라지다니…. 시이나…,: Shiina? What did you say? Gone...? Shiina...
strings.언제부터 이런 걸 느낀 거야?: Since when have you been able to sense things like this?
I suppose since I started learning magic...
This isn't something magic can sense. This is...
strings.(데이나가 조용히 시이나를 끌어당겨 품에 안는다.): (Dayna quietly draws Shiina into an embrace.)
Don't apologize. Our little sister has done nothing wrong. This is...
Dayna, don't hate Her Majesty... I mean, our eldest sister.
strings.(데이나가 시이나의 손을 붙잡고 가볍게 미소를 짓는다.): (Dayna takes Shiina's hand and offers a gentle smile.)
I'll make an exception and tell you this time.
strings.제피로스 이사장과 클로리스 교장에게 나를 안내해줘. 그리고 끝나면 바로: Take me to Chairman Zephyros and Headmistress Chloris. Then we'll eat together as soon as we're done.
Of course, Dayna. The dining hall has a good menu today.
strings.(그렇게 데이나와 시이나의 모습이 사라지고, 두 사람의 모습을 오랫동안: (Dayna and Shiina depart. A girl who seems to have been watching them for some time emerges.)
I thought I could hide somewhere so full of magic, but this place won't work either.
What could those two have been through...?
Not my business... I'd better go.
strings.(소녀가 뒤돌아 가려는데, 누군가와 부딪치고 만다. 부딪친 대상이 그대로: (As the girl turns to leave, she bumps into someone. The other person falls, and the girl hurriedly helps them up.)
strings.너 누구야? 그건 그렇고 왜 날 고양이라 부르는 거지…?: Who are you? And why are you calling me a kitten...?
Me? Just a mercenary captain passing through.
How did you see me? Ordinary humans shouldn't be able to...
strings.나는 고양이 찾는 일에는 익숙하거든, 아기 고양이. 자, 가자. 내게: I'm used to finding cats, little kitten. Come along. Someone hired me to find you. Will you come?
It's your choice. Of course, if you want to know who it is, you'll have to follow me.
strings.(모닥불 피어오르는 소리밖에 들리지 않는 어떤 공간, 그 앞에 누군가 홀: (In a place where only a campfire crackles, someone sits alone before the flames and sings.)
strings.기다렸던 약속의 밤…, 희망찬 저주를 노래하네♬: The promised night we've waited for... I sing a hopeful curse. ♬
strings.소원이 이뤄지려면 하기 싫은 일도 해야 하네♩: To have our wishes granted, we must do what we despise. ♩
strings.죽지 말고, 최대한 버텨야 해♬: Do not die. Hold on as long as you can. ♬
For there are those who never cease to sing the song of blood...
And so our story carries on...
O gods, our gods who fled.
Hear the song called forth by the curse you made. Leave us be.
So we may sing the verses left before this night is through...
May we not become the sacrifice of the Night of the Witch...
strings.(노래가 다 끝나기도 전에 모닥불이 꺼지고 주위가 어둠에 잠긴다.): (Before the song can end, the campfire dies, plunging everything into darkness.)
strings.(노래의 주인공이었던 누군가가 쓰러지고 난 후, 새로운 사람이 그 앞에: (After the singer collapses, someone new sits down before them and rekindles the fire.)
strings.(그리고 멈췄던 노래를 다시 이어 부른다.): (And takes up the song where it stopped.)
O girl. O girl who became a new god.
strings.부디! 우리를 눈감아 주소서♬: Please! Turn a blind eye to us. ♬
